import_basis: Warm pinned Mathlib imports in work/opica-round3-repo/.lake/packages/*/.lake/build/lib/lean. This module imports only Mathlib.
scope: Prime denominators p and r, ordinary prime numerator q distinct from p, and arbitrary natural s. Equality q*r=s*p forces p=r and q=s. For signed integer numerators and positive natural denominators b,d, different real fractions differ by at least 1/(b d), hence by at least 1/X^2 for b,d ≤ X. The resulting real ratio gap is specialized to q/p and s/r for distinct prime pairs. No cancellation, energy, or RH theorem is claimed.
